If you cancel a court reservation two hours before the scheduled start time, it falls within the late cancellation window. Members may cancel free of charge only up to six hours before the start time. Cancellations made later than six hours before the session begins, including two hours before, are subject to the late cancellation terms outlined in the policy. It is recommended to cancel as early as possible to allow courts to be available for others.

Baseline Padel has a "Child Supervision and Drop-Off" policy that applies to all branches. It ensures that responsibility for a child's welfare is always clearly defined between the parent or guardian and the club staff, with no ambiguous handover periods during which nobody is accountable for a minor's whereabouts.

This means you cannot leave your 6-year-old unattended at the club while you play. The club requires that children be supervised at all times, and responsibility for their care must be clearly assigned.
